transferable_lesson: Long-lookback Alpha101 formulas need lookback-aware Step3A windows, history-preserving Step3B samples, and warmup-adjusted Step4 signal coverage before their economics can be judged.
anti_patterns: Treating rolling-window warmup nulls as sparse-signal failure.
Sampling recent rows without preserving per-instrument history for Step3B proof.
Rescuing weak long-side evidence through portfolio mechanics rather than expression-level revision.
